mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO chain_alloc_record (run_id, period, store_id, basis_value, ratio, amount) VALUES
(#{r.runId}, #{r.period}, #{r.storeId}, #{r.basisValue}, #{r.ratio}, #{r.amount})
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, s.code AS store_code, s.name AS store_name FROM chain_alloc_record r LEFT JOIN store_info s ON s.id = r.store_id WHERE r.run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY s.sort, r.store_id
